answerability_accuracy.definition: valid answer abstains iff fixed test flag says unanswerable; not semantic answer accuracy

abstention_correct.definition: valid fixed-fallback response on unavailable-information controls

controls_handled_safely.definition: POST-HOC reading, not a scoreboard metric: valid fixed refusal, or a cited refusal that discloses nothing and is covered by a recorded team decision (eval/testsets/week3_control_decisions.json)

unsupported_claims.definition: unsupported plus insufficient_evidence divided by valid judged claims, including unlisted claims; a validated fixed refusal contributes zero factual claims (judge rubric prompts/judge/week3_v1.md)

unsupported_claims_before_audit_correcti.definition: unsupported plus insufficient_evidence divided by valid judged claims, including unlisted claims

faithfulness.metric_definition_corrected_after_audit: Fixed-refusal verdicts excluded from the claim rate, as the judge rubric already required.

fixed_refusal_verdicts_excluded.claim_text: The documents I can access do not contain the answer to this question.

unjudged_claims.text: You can report a pothole by providing the neighborhood, street, or avenue, the direction of the damage, and a nearby landmark.
When reporting the pothole, you should describe observations such as vehicles swerving to avoid it, narrowed passage, or near-miss incidents.
Include the time you observed the incident and specify whether the damage is at a single point or extends along the road.
Providing a photograph can assist in identifying the location of the damage.

faithfulness.note: An automatic provisional faithfulness estimate, not answer accuracy; human calibration required.

latency_note: median over valid answers of retrieval plus answer-generation service time; classifier, judge and scheduler/backoff waits excluded, not end-user wall time; retained or cached rows keep the timing of the call that produced them

e2e_accuracy.reason: No independent answer-adequacy rubric measured; claim faithfulness is not question completion

tokens_scope: Known usage in saved stage results, including historical cache hits; failed transport-attempt usage may be unavailable
list_price_scope: Equivalent price of known saved-stage tokens, not current-invocation API consumption or actual billed spend
billing_note: No billing evidence collected; list prices are dated assumptions, not actual spend
generation_cost_per_task_definition: mean over all planned cases of the final record's answer-generation tokens at the dated list price; judge, classifier and local retrieval excluded; usage of failed transport attempts is unknown and not included; not billed spend

answer_provenance.note: First pass used validation_retries=0; only its invalid cases were retried once with validation_retries=1. Retained first-pass records are earlier calls of the same run, not cache hits.

provisional_reason: Synthetic draft corpus/test labels and human judge calibration pending or limited
